state.paragraph: On September 24, 2013, CSC, Pamplona and Mac-Gray executed the exclusivity agreement providing for exclusive negotiations until 5 p.m. ET on October 12, 2013, subject to certain conditions, including that CSC and Pamplona not adversely change or modify the terms of the CSC/Pamplona final proposal.

ledger_rows.Note: Executed, authorized 09/23; exclusive until 5 p.m. 10/12/2013. Ends if CSC/Pamplona adversely changes the $21.25 final proposal. CSC/Pamplona then got full data-room access.
Inferred: displaced when exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona was executed; not reported told. On 09/18 it declined to improve its $18.00-$19.00 range (#36).
Outside legal counsel to CSC/Pamplona; first seen acting when it received the target's first merger agreement draft.
Rollover resolved: talks with Pamplona, allowed from 09/23, end with no Moab rollover (reported 10/07). Moab signed a voting agreement at signing.

exclusivity.instructions: `paragraph` reports that exclusivity is requested, authorised, granted, signed or extended. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
